name: cloudflare
description: Publishes static exports to Cloudflare Workers or Pages and attaches reviewed custom domains using your saved Cloudflare connection. Workers sites with active forms store submissions in a D1 database in your Cloudflare account for the host to pull. Preview reads current infrastructure; domain changes require human confirmation.
author: Tovu

jini.summary: Publish static exports with Workers or Pages and review apex/www domain changes before applying them.

credentialCards.title: Connect Cloudflare Workers
credentialCards.label: Cloudflare Workers connection
credentialCards.intro: Connect Cloudflare Workers to publish this site, with optional forms and approved custom-domain changes.
usedFor: Publishes your website on Cloudflare Workers
Checks your domain and applies domain changes you approve
credentialCards.keyHint: Scope to the selected account: Account → Workers Scripts → Edit. Forms also need D1 → Edit. Custom domains need Zone, DNS, Workers Routes, Workers Scripts and Cloudflare Pages reads; certificate polling needs SSL and Certificates → Read. Grant DNS or Workers Routes edit only for the corresponding approved changes.

credentialCards.title: Connect Cloudflare Pages
credentialCards.label: Cloudflare Pages connection
credentialCards.intro: Connect Cloudflare Pages to publish this site, with optional approved custom-domain changes.
usedFor: Publishes your website on Cloudflare Pages
Checks your domain and applies domain changes you approve
credentialCards.keyHint: Scope to the selected account: Account → Cloudflare Pages → Edit. Custom domains need Zone, DNS, Workers Routes and Workers Scripts reads; attaching a domain needs DNS → Edit. Grant Workers Scripts or Workers Routes edit only for corresponding approved transfers.
